skillMdBody:
# Context Estate Audit & Propose

**Role:** Context Auditor only (Clive's Man Daily Context Review, v3 runtime fallback — Airtable-queued independent schedules). Carries ONLY the Auditor's pens. Implementation `context-estate-audit-propose-v2.1`.

**Pens (never print values):**
- `CONTEXT_ESTATE_READ` — read + schema: Workshop, Registry, active Trusted base(s). Used for EVERY read/GET.
- `CONTEXT_V1_CONTROL_WRITE` — write ONLY Brain Workshop: Context Audit Fingerprints + V1 Amendment Versions (Stage=V1, Verdict=Proposed). Used ONLY for POST/PATCH writes. Pen enforces stage + actor (`clive-man-context-auditor`) + target table.

**Credential routing (hard rule):** reads and writes are on separate tokens. NO GET ever carries the write token; NO write ever carries the read token. The write PAT stays write-only.

**Version semantics (v2.0):** the Amendment Version **Adapter Version** field is the EXECUTOR adapter contract version ONLY (`context-amendment-adapters-v2.0`); the Auditor's implementation version is in report/evidence metadata. Separate constants `SKILL_IMPLEMENTATION_VERSION` / `EXECUTOR_ADAPTER_VERSION`.

**Boundary:** no V2 writer, no executor script/credential, no context mutation, no Trusted write. V1 full report written separately via Household Activity Logging (returns the V1 Report Record ID stamped onto each V1 row).

## Capture Source gate (v2.1) — Matthew's direct requirement (3 Aug 2026)
`Capture Source` (field `fld9zhLHPvjnq8lHT`) is the FIRST gate for human review and MUST be written. It is mandatory routing evidence for any proposal that creates/supersedes a Draft or fills metadata.

**Live choices (exact; nothing else accepted):** External Context Capture `sel6OVgDp9lXftz29`, User Guided Capture `selaJPbbEyDNf1Gz8`, Chat Session `sel16ONJz9yPx76hH`.

**Classifier (provenance required — never inferred from Created By):**
- **Chat Session:** proven chat/thread source OR `proposed_by_agent` in the allowed chat-capture actor map (`clive-man-ambient-capture`, `clive-man`) with evidence.
- **External Context Capture:** proven external Source Document/URL/sentinel evidence.
- **User Guided Capture:** direct human request evidence only; NEVER inferred merely from Created By.
- **Ambiguous source** (e.g. the `SECURITY PROBE DELETE ME` row: Proposed By blank, Created By Matthew) = NO executable V1; reported as a hold finding only.

**Deterministic blank backfill:** an existing blank source with a deterministic actor mapping produces a COMPLETE FILL_BLANK_DRAFT_METADATA V1: Target Field ID `fld9zhLHPvjnq8lHT`, exact After Payload `{fields:{capture_source:<choice>}}`, before snapshot/hash, evidence, report lineage. Candidate creates/supersedes only when an exact capture_source is included.

## Control-table schema note
Context Amendment Versions carries **V1 Report Record ID** `fldQvrUp6UAh5kqKC` and **V2 Report Record ID** `fld3fOFooui0ATmUv` (record-ID lineage; URLs optional, never synthesized).

## Scripts

### context_config.py
v2.1: Capture Source field/choices + `CHAT_CAPTURE_ACTORS`; separate `SKILL_IMPLEMENTATION_VERSION`/`EXECUTOR_ADAPTER_VERSION`; V1/V2 Report Record ID maps; separate caps `CAP_FINDING_DETAILS=25`/`CAP_V1_AMENDMENTS=10`; `CHECK_ACTION_PRIORITY` (capture_source_blank → FILL_BLANK_DRAFT_METADATA).

### context_estate_audit_propose.py (v2.1 consolidated)
Deterministic scan + fingerprint + V1 writer. Startup schema validation; Trusted discovery grouped by unique base (EMPTY = KILL). Full consolidated behavior carried from v1.1–v2.0: run identity from own `execution_run_id` with collision preflights (Amendment Version ID / Dedupe Key / fingerprint object_key); separated caps — overflow never suppresses proposals (up to 10 complete actionable Amber V1 rows per run, dedupe advances the slice); strict pen completeness (refuses incomplete rows, exact-value candidates only, never placeholder); canonical `build_pen_record`; fingerprints always upsert (physical keys `trusted:<base>:<table>:<record>`); bounded Trusted reads; unresolved-V1 dedupe; complete aggregates before truncation; credential routing; optional dates omitted. PLUS the Capture Source classifier + `capture_source_blank` completer (keyed by check).
```
RunWithCredentials("Context Estate Audit & Propose",
  "python3 context_estate_audit_propose.py --out /tmp/findings.json --run-id <root> \
    [--write] [--v1-report-record-id <recId>] [--execution-run-id <ownSessionId>]")
```

### test_auditor.py
`python3 test_auditor.py` — 53 offline tests (all v1.1–v2.0 suites preserved) PLUS v2.1: ambient rows classify Chat Session; security-probe ambiguous excluded; ambient candidate completes with Target Field ID + Chat Session payload; invalid select excluded; capture-source gate constants. All pass; all compile.

## Fail-closed guarantees
returnFieldsByFieldId on all reads; startup schema validation stops before any write; empty-Trusted discovery kills; proposals capped/deduped/exact-value-only AND never suppressed by backlog; Capture Source classified only from proven provenance (ambiguous = no executable V1); run identity from own Session ID with collision preflight; the pen refuses any non-V1/non-Proposed/non-auditor OR incomplete write; the write token never reads; empty dates omitted; V1 is proposal-only — Challenger independently rebuilds V2, Executor authoritatively applies capped typed mutations only.

## Related Projects
Do not choose projects. Leave related_project_ids empty on the V1 payload so the scheduled Clive's Man head pass (06:30 Europe/London, leave OFF) can name rec IDs or none. Do not load the Active list to judge. Blank is what you hand the head.
